syncPushPolicy: Only same-origin material-lists/catalogue push with empty mutations array
readinessPolicy: Must observe real compiled preferences-ready true; false-only fails. No injected frames or QueryCache certificate grants.
validation: Ten parser/context fixtures pass, including actual fetchRequestHandler JSONL under application/json, normal mutation/403, streamed BAD_REQUEST on HTTP200, producer wire and isolation. Source syntax checked; v3 app runtime not executed.

observationDecoder.method: Actual observed request trpc-accept selects JSONL, regardless response Content-Type; same installed jsonlStreamConsumer/SuperJSON; no guessed-body fallback.
observationDecoder.memoryLimit: Playwright buffers an observed body; content-length is rejected early if present, otherwise size is rejected after receipt before parsing. No streaming memory guarantee asserted.

contextPolicy: Separate consumer/producer state; every report row labels contextId; all authority/readiness/hint/poll/reconnect assertions use consumer records only; producer used only its real mutation ACK.
listenCatchUpAssertion: Actual consumer request and successful decoded consumer preference HTTP response both start at or after LISTEN termination.
